scope: Account-wide visible claude-haiku-4-5 entries overlapping the 25-issue long follow-up, two-issue post-permissions smoke and one-issue extra; the later rescue issue is outside this window.
limitations: The count and three input-token totals match the local streamed-message aggregate, not individual request IDs or per-arm charges.
Visible output tokens and streamed initial message output are not equivalent, so no output reconciliation is claimed.
Rows were collected from dynamically shifting pages and deduplicated by displayed text; identical real rows can collapse and moving rows can be missed.
The time window can contain other account activity, including a separately recorded diagnostic.
Five visible cancellations displayed zero while upstream usage was unavailable and cost pending reconciliation; those costs remain UNKNOWN.
This is not a full invoice, a per-arm allocation, or proof that all failed calls are represented.
